cohort: The study included 77 women, with 39 diagnosed with preeclampsia and 38 with uncomplicated pregnancies, from whom blood and placental tissue samples were collected.
finding: Patients with preeclampsia exhibited significantly higher serum galectin-3 levels and placental galectin-3 expression, along with myocardial dysfunction and worse renal function parameters, compared to women with uncomplicated pregnancies.
cross-section timing: At the time of preeclampsia diagnosis and delivery for blood samples, echocardiography, and placental tissue collection.
